attributes.action: I call for a General Election now.  Let the people speak, MP's openly discuss it
attributes.background: Using this Legal Parliamentary facility, let's use it to force an open debate in Parliament, where elected MP's have to openly discuss the situation!  Like; after nearly 2 years; over 85,000 migrants have crossed the channel, unemployment up, 65% of Makesfield voted leave.  Among many other things?

rejection.details:
We have a petition open calling for general election now which you may want to sign:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
